name: Butt Kicks
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Begin running in place, kicking your heels up towards your glutes.
Aim to touch your heels to your buttocks with each kick.
Keep your thighs relatively stationary and focus on the knee bend.
Pump your arms naturally in rhythm with your legs.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain an upright posture with your core engaged.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
